label: rejected

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a barrel (hoop notches at shoulder and foot, rounded ends); top view reads as a staved ring with gold rim; A15 X/Y error 0.0 and the outline is left-right even, nothing floating.
evidence.V2: Big (bulged body) and medium (two gold hoops, rolled rim lip, recessed head) read clearly, but there is no small tier: stave joints are paint stripes only, no nails/rivets on hoops, no bung, no groove at the stave ends, and the interior head is a plain flat disc.
evidence.V3: Barrel bulge is mild and the body is tall and nearly straight-sided between hoops (2.0 x 2.7 studs), so it reads as a lightly tapered cylinder rather than a confidently exaggerated chunky barrel; hoops are thin relative to the body.
evidence.V4: Rim lip is softly rounded and the bottom edge is rounded, but the hoops are thin bands whose edges read as near-hard steps in the hoop/lid close-ups, and stave divisions have no geometric edge to catch light, so bevel treatment is uneven across the prop.
evidence.V5: Hoop and lid studio close-ups show smooth shading with no pinches, seams, z-fighting or patches; only the low segment count shows as a polygonal outline on the hoop ends and bottom curve, comparable to the PASS anchor's couplings.
evidence.V6: One wood hue in three values (light stave, dark stave, deep interior brown) plus kit gold for the hoops; clear value contrast, colourways (walnut, painted teal) keep the same discipline.
evidence.V7: 1152 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000; budget_note ok.
evidence.V8: One white material LF_VertexColor with vertex colours, kit gold accent, wood hue as the single hue, smooth shading; matches kit conventions.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision (or Cylinder part), CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; A12 pass.

evidence.V1: Reads instantly as a barrel at 64 px from front, three-quarter and top; silhouette shows the bellied body with both hoops stepping out of the outline; A15 symmetry X/Y 0.0, centred, hoops seated on the staves.
evidence.V2: Big (body) and medium (two hoops, recessed open top with rim) are clear, but the small tier is missing: the staves are vertex-colour stripes only, with no grooves, nails, rivets or chime lip, so the body reads as a flat striped surface.
evidence.V3: Conventional, fairly upright cylinder: gentle bulge, thin hoops of even width, no chunky chime or exaggerated belly, so it only partly reads as confident stylised compared with the chunky flanges of the Pipe_Run anchor.
evidence.V4: The top rim has a soft rounded roll, but the hoops are flat bands with crisp, unbevelled edges that catch no highlight (hoop close-up), so edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: No z-fighting, pinches or patches, but visible stray faceting: the polygonal hoop corner shows on the right edge of the hoop close-up, and the rim plus body segments show stepped flat shading in the studio close-ups instead of smooth shading.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: two values of warm wood brown alternating on the staves, a darker interior brown, and the kit gold on the hoops; the walnut and teal colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 1152 tris against a medium-class target of 2000 (ceiling 4000), under target.
evidence.V8: One white material with vertex colours, kit gold accent and a wood hue in up to 3 values all match; minor mismatch from the faceted rather than smooth shading and the hoops lacking the ~0.045 stud chamfer.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read as a barrel (stave stripes, two hoop notches in outline, tapered ends); top reads as a staved rim with recessed head. Bulge is mild so the silhouette leans toward a can, but it stays recognisable at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Big body + two medium hoops + recessed head, but the small tier is only colour stripes: no stave grooves, hoop rivets/nails or bung, so the mid-to-small read is thin.
evidence.V3: Chunky hoops and fat staves are stylised, but the body is tall and near-straight with a weak belly bulge; widest point sits near the top hoop rather than mid-height, so it reads partly exaggerated, not confident.
evidence.V4: Hoops carry a small chamfer that catches a highlight on the top edge, and the rim lip is softened, but staves have no edge treatment at all (colour-only boundaries) and the bottom edge rolls in rather than showing a bevel; inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (hoop/lid, studio + flat) show no patches, pinches, z-fighting or seams; faceting is the systematic per-stave planking, with only slight polygon kinks in the outline below the top hoop. Symmetry error X/Y 0.0, A17/A18 clean.
evidence.V6: One wood hue in three values (light stave, dark stave, darker head) plus gold accent; walnut and painted teal colourways keep the same disciplined structure.
evidence.V7: 1152 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000: well under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material, gold accent and smooth stylised shading match the Pipe_Run anchor's look; wood hue held to 3 values as the kit allows.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).
